description: List the saved LinkedIn posts inside a smart folder (filtered view). Pass the folder's slug (from list_smart_folders). Optionally pass 'bucket' to return only one tab/stage (triage bucket) of the folder; omit it for all posts in the folder. Paginate with 'cursor' (a numeric offset) and 'limit'.

bucket.description: Tab/stage name within the folder (a triage bucket); omit for all posts in the folder.

name: get_smart_folder_posts
